name: Registered structural lane-change sensitivity of Part A v2 general (TRAIN only, zero SUMO)
question: Would a standard structural lane-change addition (V-a persistence 2.0 s, V-b discretionary manoeuvre time 4.0 s, V-c strategic early merge with zero threshold + b_merge 1.0 m/s^2 from the merge-zone start, and V-abc) substantially improve Part A v2g accuracy on the 32 PA2G-A2 TRAIN worlds - enough to justify owner option 2 - under the pre-registered BIG/MODEST/NO-IMPROVEMENT decision rule?
controller: Part A v2 general (partA_v2g engine.py) with the LC2 structural variants implemented as OFF-by-default flags in an injected lc_variants section (variants_lc2.json + variants.py); params_nominal.json UNCHANGED (param_set_id BA1FD93F0A21B1FFD2CDF20693E74FB8E3FBB8E4A1C57E7F88D9A3929E3455CE, verified pre/post); a-priori values only, no tuning/sweep/selection
baseline_cf: The registered nominal v2g path on identical worlds/windows, byte-identity enforced: flags-off output equals the PRE-change reference (lc2_nominal_ref.py through the untouched eval_a2.window_rows) on the first two panel worlds, and the full nominal aggregates equal the frozen post-LC1 A2 summary exactly (all H counts and s_RMSE means)
scenario: The same 32 PA2G-A2 TRAIN worlds of chunk 4 (results/lc1_a2_worlds32.json), 18 windows each (w = t0+30k, k=1..18), H in {10,30,60,120}, post-LC1 counting convention; truth = <world>__native_base/run/physics_steps.jsonl
seeds_splits: TRAIN worlds only (plan split asserted per world before every file open; CALIBRATION/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT never opened; assert_train_only passed; 33 opened files listed in results/lc2/lc2_opened_run_files.json); deterministic engine, no seeds
observation_contract: Timestamped 0.5 s self states + locally detected neighbours of the logged truth; no true penetration, no hidden driver type, no global traffic metric as online input; matched counterfactual outcomes are offline labels only
privileged_info: None online; raw physics rows are offline truth labels
changed_vars: Exactly the registered structural variants (one a-priori value each): V-a T_persist 2.0 s (4 consecutive qualifying steps), V-b T_lc 4.0 s discretionary-only manoeuvre block (mandatory merges ungated), V-c zero merge incentive threshold + 1.0 m/s^2 merge bias with unchanged safe-gap tests, V-abc combined; OFF by default in the engine
fixed_vars: params_nominal.json (verified unchanged), the 32-world panel, window/H definitions, metric definitions (post-LC1 counting), world-bootstrap procedure (B=2000, seed 20260930, world resampling), zero SUMO, the pre-registered decision rule
comparators: Each variant vs nominal on identical worlds/windows (paired world bootstrap); nominal vs the frozen post-LC1 A2 aggregates (exact equality)
matching_reuse: Reuses the LC1/A2 harness (eval_a2 window code, engine, metrics, 32-world panel) without re-running comparators (no p3o/const-speed/sweep); pre-change reference generated before the engine edit for the byte-identity gate
requested_vs_delivered: All registered outputs delivered: variant flags OFF-by-default with unit tests (13 green: V-a 4-step firing + reset, V-b 4.0 s block + merges unaffected, V-c zero threshold + bias + unchanged safety, nominal byte-identity engine-level and vs the pre-change reference), nominal + 4 variants x 32 TRAIN worlds, pre-registered decision rule applied verbatim, REPORT_PA2G_LC2.md (specs + provenance incl. 'to verify' flags, full table, CIs, verdicts, recommendation, delay-scope note), raw rows saved before aggregation, ledger draft
budget_registered: Zero SUMO; CPU 5 runs (nominal + 4 variants) x 32 worlds, <= 1.5 h at <= 4 workers, wall-law work has CPU priority (workers <= 3); one ZCode task
budget_actual: Wall 1228 s (20.5 min) at 3 workers for the panel incl. the byte-identity pre-flight gate; plus ~40 s pre-change reference pass, ~192 s smoke, aggregation/bootstrap seconds - zero SUMO, no comparators re-run
attempts: 1 panel launch (completed first try after the smoke/wiring pass); 2 invalid helper-script crashes before any data pass (KeyError demand in the ref script entry build, write_text kwarg) fixed and re-run with logs preserved
results: ALL FOUR VARIANTS: NO IMPROVEMENT; recommendation 'keep textbook' (owner option 1). Nominal cross-check exact vs post-LC1 A2 (disc 4.60x/5.50x/5.99x/5.22x, merge 0.66x/0.37x/0.75x/0.92x at H10/30/60/120). V-a: s_RMSE -4.7/-8.8/-4.9 % at H10/H30/H60 (H30/H60 world-bootstrap 90% CI excluding 0) but far from -20%; H30 ratios disc 4.35x / merge 0.35x (bands [0.67,1.5]); no-harm holds. V-b: s_RMSE WORSE (+2.2/+3.6/+1.0 %), ratios unmoved - the 4 s block reorders which vehicle fires instead of reducing production. V-c: no RMSE benefit (-0.7 % at H30, CI incl. 0); moves merging in the registered direction (merge ratio H30 0.37x->0.46x with CI [+0.068,+0.110], H10 merge 398->496/607, dwell down at H30/H60/H120) at a small collision cost (0.029->0.035 per 1000 at H30, within nominal+0.1); still outside the ratio bands. V-abc: s_RMSE -8.4 % at H30 (CI excluding 0) - best overall but < 20 %, ratios 4.38x/0.43x outside bands; no-harm holds. No variant reaches any full benefit component, so none is even MODEST-with-benefit; verdicts NO IMPROVEMENT with no-harm true for all four.
criteria_verdict: Registered decision rule applied verbatim: BIG for none, MODEST for none (no benefit component met by any variant), NO IMPROVEMENT for va/vb/vc/vabc; recommendation rule therefore yields 'keep textbook' with no smallest BIG variant to name
limitations: TRAIN-only evidence with a priori values (registered caveat: an adopted variant needs fresh evaluation worlds because C4L1 consumes the chunk-4 CAL); single chunk, 32 worlds; the manoeuvre-time variant interacts with the engine's front-most-first candidate order, so its panel effect is a reordering rather than an independent mechanism; dead-end stops use a window-level tracked convention (constant 72 pre-existing stops), not LC1's whole-run census of 48; dwell/early-edge computed within H; no untracked-arrival effects (Part A is tracked-scope)
review_status: draft (integrating agent to append to protocols/experiment_history.json; shared records untouched by this task)
next_action: Owner: keep the textbook model (option 1 stands per LC1); the registered structural additions V-a/V-b/V-c do not clear the pre-registered benefit bar on TRAIN. If the owner still wants a structural addition, a new registration would need a different mechanism (e.g. anticipation/lateral dynamics per LC1 option 2c) and fresh evaluation worlds.
